packageDocs.summary: API gateway: JWT-verifying usage endpoints, gateway proxy middleware, and usage UI. Components read the bearer token from the auth token store (machi_access_token) and call the usage endpoint — mount GET /api/usage as a route handler and protect it with the gateway middleware.
requiresProviders: AuthProvider (recommended — supplies the session token; otherwise tokens must already exist in localStorage)

UsageCard.description: Displays weekly API usage with a progress bar; refreshes over HTTP and live via Realtime INSERT events on usage_limits. Sends the bearer token from machi_access_token/access_token localStorage.
requiresEnv: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL + NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY (Realtime; skips gracefully when unset)
